text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? Ending up with a different heroine!?
Uuugh, that leaves such a bad taste in my mouth~~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, they broke up in the end!?
Get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Season 3, we've just got to go for it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart had gotten way too into the drama
and stayed up late...
